Container.Name: Minifold
Container.Overview:
Minifold is a lightweight, self-hosted file compressor. Drop in images, PDFs, videos or any other file, pick a level and download smaller files in the same format.
Features: - Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, AVIF, TIFF (BMP becomes PNG) - PDFs and videos (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM) - Any other file is packed with zstd - Four levels: Low, Medium, High, Extra - Abort a slow file and retry it with another level or a faster method - Light and dark mode with pastel color themes
Privacy: everything is processed on this server. Nothing is sent anywhere else. Location, camera and author details are removed by default.
Admin page: http://[server]:[port]/admin for size limits, retention, metadata, themes and GPU encoding.
Sign-in: set the Access token and Admin token below. Leave a token empty to turn that sign-in off (only on a network you trust).
Optional GPU video encoding, added to Extra Parameters: - Intel/AMD: --device=/dev/dri --group-add=GID (GID from: stat -c %g /dev/dri/renderD128) - NVIDIA: --runtime=nvidia, plus the variables NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,video,utility

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Files while they're being compressed. Deleted automatically by the retention settings. Needs free space of at least 2.5x the max file size.

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: Password for everyone using Minifold. Any length and any characters. Leave empty to turn sign-in off: then anyone who can reach this port can use Minifold.

Config.Name: Admin token
Config.Description: Password for the admin page (/admin). Any length and any characters, and it may be the same as the access token. Leave empty to turn admin sign-in off: then anyone who can reach this port can change the settings.
